name: lua_use_player2
code:
local scn, done = ...
for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindByClass("prop_physics")) do e:Remove() end
local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
local start, ang = Vector(700, -600, -143.6), Angle(0, 90, 0)
local uses, finds, samples, t, other = {}, {}, {}, -60, nil
local function held(tk)
  if tk >= 0 and tk < 20 then return IN_USE end
  if tk >= 100 and tk < 120 then return IN_USE end
  return 0
end
hook.Add("PlayerUse", "parity_use_player2", function(ply, ent)
  if ply == bot then uses[#uses+1] = { t = t, ent = ent:GetClass(), other = ent == other } end
end)
hook.Add("FindUseEntity", "parity_use_player2", function(ply, ent)
  if ply == bot then finds[#finds+1] = { t = t, ent = IsValid(ent) and ent:GetClass() or "" } end
end)
hook.Add("StartCommand", "parity_use_player2", function(ply, cmd)
  if ply == other then cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement() return end
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  cmd:ClearButtons() cmd:ClearMovement()
  cmd:SetButtons(held(t))
  cmd:SetViewAngles(t >= 100 and Angle(20, 90, 0) or ang)
end)
hook.Add("SetupMove", "parity_use_player2", function(ply, mv, cmd)
  if ply ~= bot then return end
  if t < 0 then mv:SetOrigin(start) mv:SetVelocity(Vector(0,0,0)) mv:SetButtons(0) else mv:SetButtons(held(t)) end
end)
local function tr(mask, hull)
  local a = bot:EyePos()
  local b = Vector(700, -540, -100)
  local r
  if hull then r = util.TraceHull({ start = a, endpos = b, filter = bot, mask = mask, mins = Vector(-16,-16,-16), maxs = Vector(16,16,16) })
  else r = util.TraceLine({ start = a, endpos = b, filter = bot, mask = mask }) end
  return { hit = IsValid(r.Entity) and r.Entity:GetClass() or (r.Hit and "world" or ""), frac = r.Fraction, other = r.Entity == other }
end
hook.Add("Think", "parity_use_player2", function()
  t = t + 1
  if t == -50 then RunConsoleCommand("bot") end
  if t == -30 then
    for _, b in ipairs(player.GetBots()) do if b ~= bot then other = b end end
    if IsValid(other) then other:SetPos(Vector(700, -540, -143.6)) other:SetEyeAngles(Angle(0, -90, 0)) end
  end
  if t == -20 and IsValid(other) then other:SetPos(Vector(700, -540, -143.6)) end
  if (t >= -2 and t < 6) or (t >= 98 and t < 106) then
    local near = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(ents.FindInSphere(Vector(700, -540, -110), 40)) do near[#near+1] = e:GetClass() end
    samples[#samples+1] = { t = t, eye = bot:EyePos(), eyetrace = IsValid(bot:GetEyeTrace().Entity) and bot:GetEyeTrace().Entity:GetClass() or "",
      line_solid = tr(MASK_SOLID), line_shot = tr(MASK_SHOT), line_player = tr(MASK_PLAYERSOLID), hull_player = tr(MASK_PLAYERSOLID, true),
      near = near,
      other = IsValid(other) and { pos = other:GetPos(), alive = other:Alive(), solid = other:GetSolid(), flags = other:GetSolidFlags(), group = other:GetCollisionGroup(),
        mt = other:GetMoveType(), mins = other:OBBMins(), maxs = other:OBBMaxs(), team = other:Team(), spawned = other:GetModel(), vel = other:GetVelocity() } or nil }
  end
  if t == 140 then
    for _, h in ipairs({ "Think", "PlayerUse", "FindUseEntity", "StartCommand", "SetupMove" }) do hook.Remove(h, "parity_use_player2") end
    done({ uses = uses, finds = finds, samples = samples })
  end
end)
return "async"
